items.name: theme
items.title: Livepeer UI Theme
items.description: Neutral theme for the luma style. Inter interface type, explicit Favorit display type, default radius, subtle menu accent.
items.docs: Inter is the default interface and text face. Favorit is a licensed local font reserved for explicit marketing display copy via font-display; do not apply it globally to heading elements.
